stage1.impression: A clean, competent CG interior that reads as an empty showroom, not a photographed shop: the brightest large surface is the floor (left foreground, median 88), lit in hard rectangular window-spot patches, while the products, the speaker and the drapes sit dim, and the floor reads as tiled grey planks rather than sealed concrete. The shelving is sparse (one to three objects per long bay, cards floating alone), the room has no sign of life, the lamps' tints read as scattered candy colours with no light falling from them, and the Tropos at the end of the shelves is small, dark (median 31) and lost against the shelf bay; a magazine would see a generic shop render, not a specific place.

blocking_9: The Tropos must read as the hero at a glance: its region [820,370,905,530] at lum_median >= 45, with its acrylic edges and the light through the cabinet visible, and it must not be the darkest product in the frame

The floor must stop being the brightest large surface: [0,520,520,800] lum_median <= 50, with no hard-edged rectangular light patches, and it must read at 1:1 as sealed concrete (pours, trowel marks, a soft sheen) not tiled planks
Pools of light must fall on the products (table top, shelves, bar) with darker floor between, so the frame reads lit by its practicals and spots, not flooded
The shelves and table must be dressed as a working shop: more records out and faced, Cores lit, price cards against objects, glasses on the bar, a coat or a record sleeve: some sign of people
The lit Hemispheres and Cores must visibly light their surroundings (warm pools on table and ledges) rather than sit as self-glowing coloured dots
Frame lum_median between 22 and 50 with the left-hand drapes holding texture (not a flat black wall)
Something specific to EARF and this storefront in frame (the window and street, the bar in use, the listening room's felt with light through the gap) so it reads as a particular place

defects.what: Floor is the brightest large surface (median 88.5, mean 84) and reads as grey plank tiles with hard-edged rectangular light patches from the window spots; not sealed concrete, and it pulls the eye away from the products
Tropos speaker underlit (median 31, p5 1.2) and small in frame, its teal reads murky; it does not read as hero, and the horn merges with the dark shelf bay behind it
Left felt drapes a near-flat black wall (median 8.2) covering a third of the frame; folds barely read, no wash or light through the gap
Shelving sparse: long bays with one lamp or a lone price card, empty top shelves; reads as a showroom being set up
Table base a crushed black slab (62% crushed) in the foreground with no edge definition
Table top lit flat end to end; Core lamps glow but throw no light on the walnut; the coin bowl is the only prop
Pendants over the bar and ledges are tiny white dots with no light pool below them; the purple and peach pendants read as coloured objects, not light sources
Standing ledges and the white spheres on them float in the dark with no people, glasses or context
Ceiling a dead dark band with a single track bar; no fixtures read, the 4 m volume reads as a void
Bar is a plain oak box, empty, no bottles, glasses or partner set-up; its oak reads orange and CG-smooth

changes.problem: The Tropos, the frame's hero, is darker than the floor and the shelves and reads murky.

evidence.measured: lum_median 31.1, p5 1.2, rgb median 17/35/38; the floor beside it measures 88

change.setting: track spots: the right wall's shelves (the spot nearest the plinth) / add a dedicated grazing spot on the Tropos
change.from: 40.0 W, 34 deg, aimed along the shelves
change.to: aim one right-wall spot at the Tropos at about 30 deg from above-front, 55 W, cone 22 deg, so light passes through the acrylic and lights the white batts; add a low backlight (about 8 W, 2700 K) behind the cabinet to make its polished edges glow

changes.expected: The cabinet glows teal with the batts and driver visible through it, edges rim-lit; it becomes the brightest coloured object in the right half.

changes.problem: The floor in the left foreground is the brightest large area, lit in hard rectangular patches that read as a stage.

evidence.measured: lum_median 88.5, p95 126, larger than any product's level; hard-edged rectangles visible in crop

change.setting: track spots: the window pair, and the room's fill
change.from: window pair 2 x 26 W, 20 deg; fill 0.12 W/m2
change.to: window pair 2 x 12 W, retargeted from the floor onto the bar front and table end; fill 0.06 W/m2

changes.expected: The foreground floor drops into soft shadow with gentle gradients; the eye goes to the table, shelves and speaker.

changes.problem: The floor reads as grey plank tiles, not sealed concrete.

evidence.measured: regular parallel plank seams and repeating blotches visible in the 2x crop

change.setting: materials: the floor (sealed concrete scan tinted #6A645D)
change.from: scan with plank-like seams, matte, tint #6A645D
change.to: a non-repeating poured-concrete scan with sawn control joints at about 3 m, faint trowel marks, tint #5A554F, roughness 0.35 so it carries soft reflections of the pendants and table

changes.expected: The floor reads as sealed concrete at 1:1, darker, with soft glossy reflections of the light pools.

changes.problem: The shelves and table are under-dressed, so the shop reads as a showroom being set up, not a specific shop in use.

evidence.measured: lum_median 24.1 with large empty dark bays; top two shelves of most bays hold one object or nothing

change.from: records only on the bottom shelf, lone price cards, one bowl on the table
change.to: face out three or four records per bay on the upper shelves, set every price card against its product, put a record out of its sleeve on the table's Mantle, two glasses and a bottle on the bar, a coat over a ledge

changes.expected: The shelves read full and warm, the room reads lived-in and specific.

changes.problem: The lamps glow as coloured objects but light nothing, so the light is not one coherent set of practicals.

evidence.measured: table top lit evenly by the table spot (profile 79/111/163/130/154/169), no tinted pool around either Core

change.setting: EARF's lamps: each Hemisphere and each Core
change.from: Hemisphere 4.0 W, glow 0.02; Core 0.2 W, glow 0.005
change.to: Hemisphere 12 W, glow 0.03; Core 1.5 W, glow 0.01 (light all Cores on the table and the bottom shelf); lower the table spot from 14 W to 8 W

changes.expected: Soft warm pools under each pendant and on the walnut around each Core; the table top shows falloff from its lamps rather than a flat spot.

changes.problem: The left felt drapes are a flat black wall a third of the frame wide.

change.setting: soft light: the back felt's wash
change.to: 1.4 W/m2, 2600 K, raked from the ceiling so the folds read; open a 300 mm gap in the drapes' light at the listening-room entry with the listening pair's spill showing through

changes.expected: Felt folds visible as a soft vertical rhythm, the listening room hinted behind.

changes.problem: The 24 mm lens from the door makes the room read cavernous and the speaker small; a large foreground of floor and black table base carries nothing.

evidence.measured: table base 62% crushed; floor and base fill the bottom third

change.to: position [2.2, 4.6, 1.45], 35 mm, target [7.5, 1.6, 1.0], so the table's near end and its Cores lead to the Tropos at the shelves' end, the bar on the left edge

changes.expected: Tighter, closer, cozier frame; the Tropos larger in frame on the right third.

changes.problem: The grade is neutral-grey with an orange oak; the frame's median sits just under the target band.

evidence.measured: frame lum_p50 21.8; bar oak rgb median 152/109/88 reads orange

change.setting: render: exposure, white_balance_k; the oak's stain
change.to: exposure 4.4, white_balance_k 3200; oak a slightly greyed natural stain; haze 0.0006 to 0.0012 so the spots show faint cones

changes.expected: Frame median in band, warm but not orange, a little atmosphere around the pendants.

out_of_scope.request: Make the Tropos larger or more saturated so it dominates the frame
out_of_scope.why: Its size and tint are fixed; only its light and its place in the frame (camera) may change

out_of_scope.request: Move the speaker forward from the shelves' end onto the table axis
out_of_scope.why: The plan (A-401) fixes where the plinths stand

out_of_scope.request: Reduce the number of tinted products in view so the speaker is the only saturated colour
out_of_scope.why: The card fixes that the shop shows the line in its tints
